An '''intravenous water drip''' was used to provide patients with [[Water/Legends|water]]. 

[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] in [[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trances]] could [[Death/Legends|die]] due to a lack of water after one [[Standard week/Legends|week]] in a dry climate or one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] in a wet climate. Connecting them to an intravenous water drip allowed them to extend the trance for up to three months.<ref name="RPG" />

After this time, they could die of starvation unless supported by an [[Intravenous sugar-solution drip]].<ref name="RPG" />
